overview: The Medford School Committee met to review administrative reports, approve the 2017–2018 school calendar, and authorize travel funding for the high school Ethics Bowl team. The committee also received updates on capital planning, AED compliance, guidance operations, and class sizes.

items.title: Routine Business
items.summary: Approved the meeting minutes of February 6, 2017, as well as bills, fund transfers, and payrolls.

items.title: Committee of the Whole Report on Capital Planning
items.summary: Received and placed on file the report from the Committee of the Whole meeting concerning district capital planning, grants, and building maintenance.

items.title: MHS Ethics Bowl Team Recognition and Travel Approval
items.summary: Recognized the Medford High School Ethics Bowl team for regional achievements and voted to pay for their travel to the national competition in North Carolina.

items.title: Donation in Memory of Jean Barry Sutherland
items.summary: Accepted a donation of a bench and plaque for the Columbus School grounds in memory of former principal Jean Barry Sutherland.

items.title: 2017-2018 School Calendar Approval
items.summary: Approved the proposed 2017–2018 school year calendar establishing an August 28 start date for teachers.

items.title: Professional Development Day Report
items.summary: Received a report on scheduled staff workshops and online MCAS test preparation for the March 13 professional development day.

items.title: Guidance Department Pre-Budget Report
items.summary: Accepted the Guidance Department pre-budget report highlighting support programs, PSAT participation, and updated freshman course choices.

items.title: Report on Transgender Student Rights and Educational Access
items.summary: Received an update outlining state laws protecting transgender students and affirming free public education access regardless of immigration status.

items.title: Automated External Defibrillator Law Compliance
items.summary: Reviewed AED readiness across schools and voted to post a list of certified personnel next to all district defibrillators.

items.title: Elementary Class Size Update
items.summary: Placed on file an updated breakdown of class sizes across all district elementary school grade levels.

items.title: Reasonable Use Policy Approval
items.summary: Approved the updated technology reasonable use policy with an amendment requiring parent or guardian signatures.

items.title: Resolutions and Announcements
items.summary: Approved resolutions of condolence for former district staff members and community figures before receiving closing announcements.
